label: Own-nature carriage REQUIRES_LACK_2, from simplicity, seating, realization and transfer (inference)
rule: Simplicity identifies the seat of a condition with the constituent that realizes the root's determination; transfer in the root then gives the condition
meaning: The derivation of ownCarriageFromUnity with requirement in the root (REQUIRES_LACK_2) throughout. Its transfer premise TRANSFER_2 is the one the identity thesis for simple beings supports: the one constituent is, in reality, each determination it realizes, so what its condition excludes is required to be lacking in the root by each of them. A simple root that lacks noesis by a clause of its one nature meets every premise and the conclusion (simpleUnityCarriageMap, clause 3): its lack of noesis has a positive ground in the root, its one nature. The main theorem uses no axioms.
